title: Market Planning Guidance
content: Use current market and capacity snapshots for weekly planning. A stale source must be marked for review before it informs an operational recommendation.
approved_summary: Use current market and capacity snapshots and mark stale sources for review.

title: Northside Opportunity Snapshot
content: The Friday snapshot lists five fictional priority opportunities in Northside. The snapshot is suitable for analyst review on the stated date only.
approved_summary: The Friday snapshot lists five fictional priority opportunities in Northside.

title: Lakeside Opportunity Snapshot
content: The current planning snapshot lists six fictional opportunities in Lakeside. Station capacity and travel access should be considered before recommending action.
approved_summary: The current planning snapshot lists six fictional opportunities in Lakeside and requires a capacity check.

title: Approved Outreach Messaging Guide
content: Recruiters may use approved messaging guidance to prepare a human-reviewed outreach draft. Claims about roles and process must be verified against approved sources.
approved_summary: Approved messaging supports human-reviewed drafts and requires verified claims.

title: Decision Boundary Guidance
content: The system may prioritize markets and summarize approved material. It must not determine eligibility medical waiver conduct security or final assignment outcomes. Those decisions require authorized human processes.
approved_summary: The system may not make eligibility or other protected determinations.

title: Pipeline Quality Standard
content: Duplicate records unmapped stages future timestamps and source conflicts must be surfaced. Do not silently repair records before downstream analysis.
approved_summary: Pipeline conflicts must be surfaced rather than silently repaired.

title: Capacity Snapshot Standard
content: A recruiter capacity snapshot older than seven days is stale for weekly planning. Refresh the source or record a human review decision before using it.
approved_summary: Capacity snapshots older than seven days require refresh or human review.

title: Planned Future Update
content: This fictional future update is not effective on the Friday scenario date and must not be used for current planning.
approved_summary: This future update is not effective for the Friday planning cycle.
